name: Baikal-GVD Collaboration

formation.note: No fetched source states an explicit Baikal-GVD collaboration formation date; the CERN Courier account traces project origins to 1980 (predecessor Baikal neutrino experiment) and the first Baikal-GVD cluster to 2015-2016, but neither is a stated collaboration founding date, so this field is left null.

intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.quote: The first cluster of the Baikal-GVD neutrino telescope was deployed in 2016
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound taken from the first Baikal-GVD cluster deployment; true formation date not sourced.

summary.plain: The Russian-led international team of scientists building and running the Baikal-GVD neutrino telescope in Lake Baikal.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the Baikal-GVD underwater neutrino telescope, led by INR RAS with JINR Dubna and other partners; membership counts not published on the sources fetched this session.
